text: {"assertions":["A partial upload bug in storage/blob/uploader.rs was identified and fixed on 2026-06-07.","The bug occurred when the input list came in empty during upload operations.","The bug could be reproduced by uploading a 40 MB fixture over a throttled network link.","The root cause was an N+1 query hidden behind a lazy relation.","The symptom was a final upload part that never received acknowledgment.","The fix prefetched the relation in a single query via PR #3382 on branch fix/partial-upload-1.","The nightly rollup had matched source counts correctly for 75 consecutive days before the fix was applied.","This bug occurred in the same area of storage/blob/uploader.rs where earlier partial upload issues had been worked on."]}
